name: midnight-survey-dapp
description: Production-ready privacy-preserving survey DApp using Midnight SDK

scripts.build: pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-types build && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-sdk build && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/contracts build && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/backend build && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-types test && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-sdk test && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/contracts test && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/backend test && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/frontend test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-types test:unit && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-sdk test:unit && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/backend test:unit && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/frontend test:unit
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-types lint && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-sdk lint && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/contracts lint && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/backend lint && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/frontend lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-types lint:fix && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-sdk lint:fix && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/contracts lint:fix && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/backend lint:fix && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/frontend lint:fix
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-types clean && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/shared-sdk clean && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/contracts clean && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/backend clean && pnpm --filter=@midnight-survey/frontend clean
scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean && rm -rf node_modules .turbo dist coverage .turbo

author: Midnight Survey DApp Team
